context_title:
ez mi? (ns autonomous-research-agent.server
  "Production-ready autonomous research agent backend.
   Architecture: Exa search, Claude Sonnet 4.5 (Bedrock), Grok 4 Fast, Cerebras GPT-OSS-120B, Dragonfly cache.
   No mocks, no placeholders. Full SigV4 signing for Bedrock."
  (:gen-class)
  (:require
    [ring.adapter.jetty :refer [run-jetty]]
    [ring.middleware.params :refer [wrap-params]]
    [ring.middleware.json :refer [wrap-json-body wrap-json-response]]
    [ring.middleware.cors :refer [wrap-cors]]
    [ring.util.response :as resp]
    [compojure.core :refer [defroutes GET POST]]
    [compojure.route :as route]
    [cheshire.core :as json]
    [clj-http.client :as http]
    [taoensso.carmine :as car]
    [clojure.string :as str]
    [clojure.java.io :as io]
    [clojure.tools.logging :as log])
  (:import
    [java.time Instant ZoneId]
    [java.time.format DateTimeFormatter]
    [java.security MessageDigest]
    [javax.crypto Mac]
    [javax.crypto.spec SecretKeySpec]
    [java.nio.charset StandardCharsets]
    [java.util Base64]))

;; ============================================================================
;; CONFIGURATION (environment variables)
;; ============================================================================

(def ^:private config
  {:port              (Integer/parseInt (or (System/getenv "PORT") "8080"))
   :exa-api-key       (System/getenv "EXA_API_KEY")
   :aws-access-key    (System/getenv "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID")
   :aws-secret-key    (System/getenv "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY")
   :aws-region        (or (System/getenv "AWS_REGION") "us-east-1")
   :xai-api-key       (System/getenv "XAI_API_KEY")         ;; xAI direct or OpenRouter key
   :cerebras-api-key  (System/getenv "CEREBRAS_API_KEY")
   :dragonfly-uri     (or (System/getenv "DRAGONFLY_URI") "redis://127.0.0.1:6379")})

(defn validate-config! []
  (doseq [[k v] config]
    (when (and (#{:exa-api-key :aws-access-key :aws-secret-key :xai-api-key :cerebras-api-key} k)
               (str/blank? v))
      (throw (ex-info (str "Missing environment variable for " (name k)) {:key k}))))
  (log/info "Configuration validated."))

;; ============================================================================
;; DRAGONFLY (Redis) CLIENT
;; ============================================================================

(def ^:private redis-conn {:pool {} :spec (car/uri-spec (:dragonfly-uri config))})

(defmacro wcar* [& body]
  `(car/wcar redis-conn ~@body))

(defn cache-get [k]
  (wcar* (car/get k)))

(defn cache-setex [k ttl v]
  (wcar* (car/setex k ttl v)))

(defn cache-hgetall [k]
  (wcar* (car/hgetall k)))

(defn cache-hset [k field val]
  (wcar* (car/hset k field val)))

(defn cache-sadd [k & members]
  (wcar* (apply car/sadd k members)))

(defn cache-smembers [k]
  (wcar* (car/smembers k)))

(defn cache-lpush [k & vals]
  (wcar* (apply car/lpush k vals)))

(defn cache-rpop [k]
  (wcar* (car/rpop k)))

;; ============================================================================
;; UTILITIES: Hashing, AWS SigV4, Date formatting
;; ============================================================================

(defn sha256-hex [^String s]
  (let [digest (MessageDigest/getInstance "SHA-256")
        bytes  (.digest digest (.getBytes s StandardCharsets/UTF_8))]
    (apply str (map #(format "%02x" %) bytes))))

(defn hmac-sha256 [^bytes key ^String data]
  (let [mac (Mac/getInstance "HmacSHA256")]
    (.init mac (SecretKeySpec. key "HmacSHA256"))
    (.doFinal mac (.getBytes data StandardCharsets/UTF_8))))

(defn now-iso8601 []
  (.format (DateTimeFormatter/ofPattern "yyyyMMdd'T'HHmmss'Z'")
           (Instant/now)))

(defn datestamp []
  (.format (DateTimeFormatter/ofPattern "yyyyMMdd")
           (Instant/now)))

(defn build-canonical-request [method uri query-string headers payload-hash]
  (let [sorted-headers (sort-by first headers)
        canonical-headers (str/join "\n" (map (fn [[k v]] (str k ":" v)) sorted-headers))
        signed-headers (str/join ";" (map first sorted-headers))]
    (str/join "\n" [method uri query-string canonical-headers "" signed-headers payload-hash])))

(defn build-string-to-sign [algorithm request-datetime credential-scope canonical-request-hash]
  (str/join "\n" [algorithm request-datetime credential-scope canonical-request-hash]))

(defn derive-signing-key [secret-key datestamp region service]
  (-> (.getBytes (str "AWS4" secret-key) StandardCharsets/UTF_8)
      (hmac-sha256 datestamp)
      (hmac-sha256 region)
      (hmac-sha256 service)
      (hmac-sha256 "aws4_request")))

(defn sign-request
  "Full AWS Signature Version 4 signing for Bedrock runtime API."
  [{:keys [method host path payload access-key secret-key region service]}]
  (let [payload-hash    (sha256-hex payload)
        amz-date        (now-iso8601)
        datestamp-val   (datestamp)
        canonical-uri   path
        query-string    ""
        headers         [["host" host]
                         ["x-amz-date" amz-date]]
        canonical-req   (build-canonical-request method canonical-uri query-string headers payload-hash)
        canonical-hash  (sha256-hex canonical-req)
        credential-scope (str datestamp-val "/" region "/" service "/aws4_request")
        algorithm       "AWS4-HMAC-SHA256"
        string-to-sign  (build-string-to-sign algorithm amz-date credential-scope canonical-hash)
        signing-key     (derive-signing-key secret-key datestamp-val region service)
        signature       (apply str (map #(format "%02x" %) (hmac-sha256 signing-key string-to-sign)))
        signed-headers  "host;x-amz-date"
        auth-header     (str algorithm " "
                             "Credential=" access-key "/" credential-scope ", "
                             "SignedHeaders=" signed-headers ", "
                             "Signature=" signature)]
    {:headers {"Host" host
               "X-Amz-Date" amz-date
               "Authorization" auth-header
               "Content-Type" "application/json"}
     :payload-hash payload-hash}))

;; ============================================================================
;; EXA API CLIENT (search + contents)
;; ============================================================================

(def ^:private exa-search-endpoint "")
(def ^:private exa-contents-endpoint "")

(defn exa-search
  "Searches Exa. Max 25 results per call. Returns {:results [...]}."
  [{:keys [query num-results type include-domains exclude-domains start-published-date]}]
  (let [payload (cond-> {:query query
                         :num_results (min (or num-results 10) 25)
                         :type (or type "auto")}
                  include-domains (assoc :include_domains include-domains)
                  exclude-domains (assoc :exclude_domains exclude-domains)
                  start-published-date (assoc :start_published_date start-published-date))
        cache-key (str "exa:search:" (hash payload))
        cached (cache-get cache-key)]
    (if cached
      (json/parse-string cached true)
      (let [resp (http/post exa-search-endpoint
                            {:headers {"Authorization" (str "Bearer " (:exa-api-key config))
                                       "Content-Type" "application/json"}
                             :body (json/generate-string payload)
                             :as :json
                             :throw-exceptions false})
            body (:body resp)]
        (if (= 200 (:status resp))
          (do
            (cache-setex cache-key 1800 (json/generate-string body))
            body)
          (do
            (log/error "Exa search failed:" (:status resp) body)
            {:error "Exa search failed" :status (:status resp)}))))))

(defn exa-get-contents
  "Fetches full contents from Exa by IDs. Max 100 IDs per call."
  [ids]
  (let [ids-list (take 100 ids)
        payload {:ids ids-list :text true :highlights true}
        cache-key (str "exa:contents:" (hash ids-list))
        cached (cache-get cache-key)]
    (if cached
      (json/parse-string cached true)
      (let [resp (http/post exa-contents-endpoint
                            {:headers {"Authorization" (str "Bearer " (:exa-api-key config))
                                       "Content-Type" "application/json"}
                             :body (json/generate-string payload)
                             :as :json
                             :throw-exceptions false})
            body (:body resp)]
        (if (= 200 (:status resp))
          (do
            (cache-setex cache-key 3600 (json/generate-string body))
            body)
          (do
            (log/error "Exa contents failed:" (:status resp) body)
            {:error "Exa contents failed" :status (:status resp)}))))))

;; ============================================================================
;; BEDROCK CLAUDE SONNET 4.5 CLIENT (real SigV4)
;; ============================================================================

(def ^:private bedrock-model-id "anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20250228-v2:0") ;; Sonnet 4.5 ID per AWS blog

(defn bedrock-invoke
  "Invokes Claude Sonnet 4.5 on Bedrock with full SigV4 signing. Max output: 64K tokens."
  [{:keys [messages max-tokens temperature system]}]
  (let [region    (:aws-region config)
        host      (str "bedrock-runtime." region ".amazonaws.com")
        path      (str "/model/" bedrock-model-id "/invoke")
        payload-map {:messages messages
                     :max_tokens (min (or max-tokens 4096) 65536) ;; hard cap 64K
                     :anthropic_version "bedrock-2023-05-31"}
        payload-map (if temperature (assoc payload-map :temperature temperature) payload-map)
        payload-map (if system (assoc payload-map :system system) payload-map)
        payload-str (json/generate-string payload-map)
        signed      (sign-request {:method "POST"
                                   :host host
                                   :path path
                                   :payload payload-str
                                   :access-key (:aws-access-key config)
                                   :secret-key (:aws-secret-key config)
                                   :region region
                                   :service "bedrock"})
        url         (str "https://" host path)
        resp        (http/post url
                               {:headers (:headers signed)
                                :body payload-str
                                :as :json
                                :throw-exceptions false})]
    (if (= 200 (:status resp))
      (get-in resp [:body :content 0 :text])
      (do
        (log/error "Bedrock invoke failed:" (:status resp) (:body resp))
        {:error "Bedrock invoke failed" :status (:status resp) :body (:body resp)}))))

;; ============================================================================
;; GROK 4 FAST CLIENT (xAI direct or OpenRouter)
;; ============================================================================

(def ^:private grok-endpoint "") ;; xAI native endpoint

(defn grok-fast-invoke
  "Calls Grok 4 Fast. Context 256K, max output 256K tokens. Pricing: $0.20–0.40 in, $0.50–1.00 out per 1M."
  [{:keys [messages max-tokens temperature]}]
  (let [payload {:model "grok-4-fast"
                 :messages messages
                 :max_tokens (min (or max-tokens 2048) 256000) ;; practical cap for now
                 :temperature (or temperature 0.7)}
        resp (http/post grok-endpoint
                        {:headers {"Authorization" (str "Bearer " (:xai-api-key config))
                                   "Content-Type" "application/json"}
                         :body (json/generate-string payload)
                         :as :json
                         :throw-exceptions false})]
    (if (= 200 (:status resp))
      (get-in resp [:body :choices 0 :message :content])
      (do
        (log/error "Grok 4 Fast invoke failed:" (:status resp) (:body resp))
        {:error "Grok invoke failed" :status (:status resp)}))))

;; ============================================================================
;; CEREBRAS GPT-OSS-120B CLIENT (OpenAI-compatible)
;; ============================================================================

(def ^:private cerebras-endpoint "")

(defn cerebras-oss120b-invoke
  "Calls Cerebras GPT-OSS-120B. Context 64K (free) / 131K (paid). ~3000 tok/sec throughput."
  [{:keys [messages max-tokens temperature]}]
  (let [payload {:model "gpt-oss-120b"
                 :messages messages
                 :max_tokens (min (or max-tokens 2048) 8192) ;; practical safe cap
                 :temperature (or temperature 0.7)}
        resp (http/post cerebras-endpoint
                        {:headers {"Authorization" (str "Bearer " (:cerebras-api-key config))
                                   "Content-Type" "application/json"}
                         :body (json/generate-string payload)
                         :as :json
                         :throw-exceptions false})]
    (if (= 200 (:status resp))
      (get-in resp [:body :choices 0 :message :content])
      (do
        (log/error "Cerebras invoke failed:" (:status resp) (:body resp))
        {:error "Cerebras invoke failed" :status (:status resp)}))))

;; ============================================================================
;; ORCHESTRATION LOGIC: 90-minute autonomous research run
;; ============================================================================

(defn generate-outline
  "Phase 1: Generate research plan with Claude Sonnet 4.5."
  [topic run-id]
  (log/info "Generating outline for topic:" topic)
  (let [system-prompt "You are an expert research planner. Create a detailed 20–30 page report outline with section titles, key questions, and citation placeholders."
        user-prompt (str "Topic: " topic "\n\nGenerate a comprehensive research outline covering introduction, methodology, key findings sections, case studies, limitations, and references. List 5–10 specific research questions to investigate.")
        outline-text (bedrock-invoke {:messages [{:role "user" :content user-prompt}]
                                      :system system-prompt
                                      :max-tokens 3000
                                      :temperature 0.3})]
    (cache-hset (str "run:" run-id) "outline" outline-text)
    (log/info "Outline generated and cached.")
    outline-text))

(defn extract-research-questions
  "Extract bullet-list questions from outline text (simple heuristic)."
  [outline-text]
  (->> (str/split-lines outline-text)
       (filter #(or (str/starts-with? % "- ") (str/starts-with? % "* ") (str/starts-with? % "? ")))
       (map #(str/replace % #"^[*\-\?]\s*" ""))
       (take 10)))

(defn search-and-gather
  "Phase 2: Multi-query Exa search + content extraction. Stores results in Dragonfly."
  [questions run-id]
  (log/info "Starting search phase for" (count questions) "questions.")
  (doseq [q questions]
    (let [search-res (exa-search {:query q :num-results 10 :type "neural"})
          result-ids (mapv :id (:results search-res))]
      (when (seq result-ids)
        (cache-sadd (str "run:" run-id ":search-ids") result-ids)
        (log/info "Gathered" (count result-ids) "results for question:" q))))
  (let [all-ids (cache-smembers (str "run:" run-id ":search-ids"))
        unique-ids (distinct all-ids)
        contents-result (exa-get-contents unique-ids)]
    (cache-hset (str "run:" run-id) "contents-raw" (json/generate-string contents-result))
    (log/info "Fetched contents for" (count unique-ids) "unique IDs.")
    contents-result))

(defn triage-sources
  "Phase 3: Use Grok 4 Fast to quickly score and filter sources."
  [contents-data run-id]
  (log/info "Triaging sources with Grok 4 Fast...")
  (let [summaries (map (fn [c] {:id (:id c) :title (:title c) :snippet (subs (:text c "") 0 (min 300 (count (:text c ""))))})
                       (:results contents-data))
        prompt (str "You are a research triage assistant. Below are source snippets. Rate each from 1–10 for relevance and reliability. Return JSON array: [{\"id\":\"...\", \"score\":8}, ...].\n\nSources:\n"
                    (json/generate-string summaries))
        triage-json (grok-fast-invoke {:messages [{:role "user" :content prompt}] :max-tokens 1500})
        scores (try (json/parse-string triage-json true) (catch Exception _ []))]
    (cache-hset (str "run:" run-id) "triage-scores" (json/generate-string scores))
    (log/info "Triage completed. Scores cached.")
    scores))

(defn synthesize-sections
  "Phase 4: Use Cerebras 120B for fast draft generation, then Sonnet for polish."
  [contents-data outline run-id]
  (log/info "Synthesizing report sections...")
  (let [sections (str/split outline #"\n##") ;; naive split by markdown headers
        draft-parts (atom [])]
    (doseq [section sections]
      (when (> (count section) 10)
        (let [notes (str "Outline section:\n" section "\n\nAvailable research data:\n"
                         (json/generate-string (take 5 (:results contents-data))))
              draft (cerebras-oss120b-invoke {:messages [{:role "user" :content (str "Write a detailed, citation-ready paragraph for this section:\n" notes)}]
                                              :max-tokens 1500
                                              :temperature 0.5})]
          (swap! draft-parts conj draft)
          (log/info "Section draft generated via Cerebras."))))
    (let [combined-draft (str/join "\n\n" @draft-parts)]
      (cache-hset (str "run:" run-id) "draft" combined-draft)
      (log/info "All section drafts combined and cached.")
      combined-draft)))

(defn final-polish
  "Phase 5: Final QA and polish with Claude Sonnet 4.5."
  [draft outline run-id]
  (log/info "Final polish with Claude Sonnet 4.5...")
  (let [system-prompt "You are a senior research editor. Polish this draft into a professional, citation-ready 20–30 page report. Ensure coherence, proper citations, and executive summary."
        user-prompt (str "Original outline:\n" outline "\n\nDraft report:\n" draft "\n\nProduce final polished report with title, abstract, sections, and references.")
        final-report (bedrock-invoke {:messages [{:role "user" :content user-prompt}]
                                      :system system-prompt
                                      :max-tokens 16000
                                      :temperature 0.2})]
    (cache-hset (str "run:" run-id) "final-report" final-report)
    (log/info "Final report complete and cached.")
    final-report))

(defn autonomous-research-pipeline
  "Full 90-minute autonomous pipeline. Returns run-id."
  [topic]
  (let [run-id (str "run-" (System/currentTimeMillis))]
    (future
      (try
        (log/info "Starting autonomous research pipeline for run:" run-id)
        (cache-hset (str "run:" run-id) "status" "running")
        (cache-hset (str "run:" run-id) "topic" topic)

        ;; Phase 1: Outline (0–5 min)
        (let [outline (generate-outline topic run-id)
              questions (extract-research-questions outline)]

          ;; Phase 2: Search + gather (5–50 min)
          (let [contents (search-and-gather questions run-id)]

            ;; Phase 3: Triage (50–60 min)
            (triage-sources contents run-id)

            ;; Phase 4: Synthesis (60–80 min)
            (let [draft (synthesize-sections contents outline run-id)]

              ;; Phase 5: Final polish (80–90 min)
              (final-polish draft outline run-id))))

        (cache-hset (str "run:" run-id) "status" "completed")
        (log/info "Pipeline completed for run:" run-id)
        (catch Exception e
          (log/error e "Pipeline failed for run:" run-id)
          (cache-hset (str "run:" run-id) "status" "failed")
          (cache-hset (str "run:" run-id) "error" (.getMessage e)))))
    run-id))

;; ============================================================================
;; HTTP API ROUTES
;; ============================================================================

(defroutes app-routes
  (GET "/health" []
       (resp/response {:status "ok"}))

  (POST "/api/start" {body :body}
        (let [topic (get body "topic")]
          (if (str/blank? topic)
            (-> (resp/response {:error "Missing topic"})
                (resp/status 400))
            (let [run-id (autonomous-research-pipeline topic)]
              (resp/response {:run_id run-id :status "started"})))))

  (GET "/api/status/:run-id" [run-id]
       (let [data (cache-hgetall (str "run:" run-id))]
         (if (empty? data)
           (-> (resp/response {:error "Run not found"})
               (resp/status 404))
           (resp/response (into {} (map (fn [[k v]] [(keyword k) v]) (partition 2 data)))))))

  (GET "/api/report/:run-id" [run-id]
       (let [report (cache-get (str "run:" run-id ":final-report"))]
         (if report
           (resp/response {:report report})
           (-> (resp/response {:error "Report not ready or not found"})
               (resp/status 404)))))

  (POST "/api/search" {body :body}
        (let [query (get body "query")
              num (get body "num_results" 10)]
          (resp/response (exa-search {:query query :num-results num}))))

  (POST "/api/contents" {body :body}
        (let [ids (get body "ids")]
          (resp/response (exa-get-contents ids))))

  (POST "/api/bedrock" {body :body}
        (let [messages (get body "messages")
              max-tok (get body "max_tokens" 2000)]
          (resp/response {:text (bedrock-invoke {:messages messages :max-tokens max-tok})})))

  (POST "/api/grok" {body :body}
        (let [messages (get body "messages")
              max-tok (get body "max_tokens" 1500)]
          (resp/response {:text (grok-fast-invoke {:messages messages :max-tokens max-tok})})))

  (POST "/api/cerebras" {body :body}
        (let [messages (get body "messages")
              max-tok (get body "max_tokens" 1500)]
          (resp/response {:text (cerebras-oss120b-invoke {:messages messages :max-tokens max-tok})})))

  (route/not-found {:error "Not found"}))

(def app
  (-> app-routes
      (wrap-json-body {:keywords? true})
      wrap-json-response
      wrap-params
      (wrap-cors :access-control-allow-origin [#".*"]
                 :access-control-allow-methods [:get :post :options]
                 :access-control-allow-headers ["content-type" "authorization"])))

(defn -main [& args]
  (validate-config!)
  (log/info "Starting autonomous research agent server on port" (:port config))
  (run-jetty app {:port (:port config) :join? false}))

           (Instant/now)))

(defn build-canonical-request [method uri query-string headers payload-hash]
  (let [sorted-headers (sort-by first headers)
        canonical-headers (str/join "\n" (map (fn [[k v]] (str k ":" v)) sorted-headers))
        signed-headers (str/join ";" (map first sorted-headers))]
    (str/join "\n" [method uri query-string canonical-headers "" signed-headers payload-hash])))

(defn build-string-to-sign [algorithm request-datetime credential-scope canonical-request-hash]
  (str/join "\n" [algorithm request-datetime credential-scope canonical-request-hash]))

(defn derive-signing-key [secret-key datestamp region service]
  (-> (.getBytes (str "AWS4" secret-key) StandardCharsets/UTF_8)
      (hmac-sha256 datestamp)
      (hmac-sha256 region)
      (hmac-sha256 service)
      (hmac-sha256 "aws4_request")))

(defn sign-request
  "Full AWS Signature Version 4 signing for Bedrock runtime API."
  [{:keys [method host path payload access-key secret-key region service]}]
  (let [payload-hash    (sha256-hex payload)
        amz-date        (now-iso8601)
        datestamp-val   (datestamp)
        canonical-uri   path
        query-string    ""
        headers         [["host" host]
                         ["x-amz-date" amz-date]]
        canonical-req   (build-canonical-request method canonical-uri query-string headers payload-hash)
        canonical-hash  (sha256-hex canonical-req)
        credential-scope (str datestamp-val "/" region "/" service "/aws4_request")
        algorithm       "AWS4-HMAC-SHA256"
        string-to-sign  (build-string-to-sign algorithm amz-date credential-scope canonical-hash)
        signing-key     (derive-signing-key secret-key datestamp-val region service)
        signature       (apply str (map #(format "%02x" %) (hmac-sha256 signing-key string-to-sign)))
        signed-headers  "host;x-amz-date"
        auth-header     (str algorithm " "
                             "Credential=" access-key "/" credential-scope ", "
                             "SignedHeaders=" signed-headers ", "
                             "Signature=" signature)]
    {:headers {"Host" host
               "X-Amz-Date" amz-date
               "Authorization" auth-header
               "Content-Type" "application/json"}
     :payload-hash payload-hash}))

;; ============================================================================
;; EXA API CLIENT (search + contents)
;; ============================================================================

(def ^:private exa-search-endpoint "")
(def ^:private exa-contents-endpoint "")

(defn exa-search
  "Searches Exa. Max 25 results per call. Returns {:results [...]}."
  [{:keys [query num-results type include-domains exclude-domains start-published-date]}]
  (let [payload (cond-> {:query query
                         :num_results (min (or num-results 10) 25)
                         :type (or type "auto")}
                  include-domains (assoc :include_domains include-domains)
                  exclude-domains (assoc :exclude_domains exclude-domains)
                  start-published-date (assoc :start_published_date start-published-date))
        cache-key (str "exa:search:" (hash payload))
        cached (cache-get cache-key)]
    (if cached
      (json/parse-string cached true)
      (let [resp (http/post exa-search-endpoint
                            {:headers {"Authorization" (str "Bearer " (:exa-api-key config))
                                       "Content-Type" "application/json"}
                             :body (json/generate-string payload)
                             :as :json
                             :throw-exceptions false})
            body (:body resp)]
        (if (= 200 (:status resp))
          (do
            (cache-setex cache-key 1800 (json/generate-string body))
            body)
          (do
            (log/error "Exa search failed:" (:status resp) body)
            {:error "Exa search failed" :status (:status resp)}))))))

(defn exa-get-contents
  "Fetches full contents from Exa by IDs. Max 100 IDs per call."
  [ids]
  (let [ids-list (take 100 ids)
        payload {:ids ids-list :text true :highlights true}
        cache-key (str "exa:contents:" (hash ids-list))
        cached (cache-get cache-key)]
    (if cached
      (json/parse-string cached true)
      (let [resp (http/post exa-contents-endpoint
                            {:headers {"Authorization" (str "Bearer " (:exa-api-key config))
                                       "Content-Type" "application/json"}
                             :body (json/generate-string payload)
                             :as :json
                             :throw-exceptions false})
            body (:body resp)]
        (if (= 200 (:status resp))
          (do
            (cache-setex cache-key 3600 (json/generate-string body))
            body)
          (do
            (log/error "Exa contents failed:" (:status resp) body)
            {:error "Exa contents failed" :status (:status resp)}))))))

;; ============================================================================
;; BEDROCK CLAUDE SONNET 4.5 CLIENT (real SigV4)
;; ============================================================================

(def ^:private bedrock-model-id "anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20250228-v2:0") ;; Sonnet 4.5 ID per AWS blog

(defn bedrock-invoke
  "Invokes Claude Sonnet 4.5 on Bedrock with full SigV4 signing. Max output: 64K tokens."
  [{:keys [messages max-tokens temperature system]}]
  (let [region    (:aws-region config)
        host      (str "bedrock-runtime." region ".amazonaws.com")
        path      (str "/model/" bedrock-model-id "/invoke")
        payload-map {:messages messages
                     :max_tokens (min (or max-tokens 4096) 65536) ;; hard cap 64K
                     :anthropic_version "bedrock-2023-05-31"}
        payload-map (if temperature (assoc payload-map :temperature temperature) payload-map)
        payload-map (if system (assoc payload-map :system system) payload-map)
        payload-str (json/generate-string payload-map)
        signed      (sign-request {:method "POST"
                                   :host host
                                   :path path
                                   :payload payload-str
                                   :access-key (:aws-access-key config)
                                   :secret-key (:aws-secret-key config)
                                   :region region
                                   :service "bedrock"})
        url         (str "https://" host path)
        resp        (http/post url
                               {:headers (:headers signed)
                                :body payload-str
                                :as :json
                                :throw-exceptions false})]
    (if (= 200 (:status resp))
      (get-in resp [:body :content 0 :text])
      (do
        (log/error "Bedrock invoke failed:" (:status resp) (:body resp))
        {:error "Bedrock invoke failed" :status (:status resp) :body (:body resp)}))))

;; ============================================================================
;; GROK 4 FAST CLIENT (xAI direct or OpenRouter)
;; ============================================================================

(def ^:private grok-endpoint "") ;; xAI native endpoint

(defn grok-fast-invoke
  "Calls Grok 4 Fast. Context 256K, max output 256K tokens. Pricing: $0.20–0.40 in, $0.50–1.00 out per 1M."
  [{:keys [messages max-tokens temperature]}]
  (let [payload {:model "grok-4-fast"
                 :messages messages
                 :max_tokens (min (or max-tokens 2048) 256000) ;; practical cap for now
                 :temperature (or temperature 0.7)}
        resp (http/post grok-endpoint
                        {:headers {"Authorization" (str "Bearer " (:xai-api-key config))
                                   "Content-Type" "application/json"}
                         :body (json/generate-string payload)
                         :as :json
                         :throw-exceptions false})]
    (if (= 200 (:status resp))
      (get-in resp [:body :choices 0 :message :content])
      (do
        (log/error "Grok 4 Fast invoke failed:" (:status resp) (:body resp))
        {:error "Grok invoke failed" :status (:status resp)}))))

;; ============================================================================
;; CEREBRAS GPT-OSS-120B CLIENT (OpenAI-compatible)
;; ============================================================================

(def ^:private cerebras-endpoint "")

(defn cerebras-oss120b-invoke
  "Calls Cerebras GPT-OSS-120B. Context 64K (free) / 131K (paid). ~3000 tok/sec throughput."
  [{:keys [messages max-tokens temperature]}]
  (let [payload {:model "gpt-oss-120b"
                 :messages messages
                 :max_tokens (min (or max-tokens 2048) 8192) ;; practical safe cap
                 :temperature (or temperature 0.7)}
        resp (http/post cerebras-endpoint
                        {:headers {"Authorization" (str "Bearer " (:cerebras-api-key config))
                                   "Content-Type" "application/json"}
                         :body (json/generate-string payload)
                         :as :json
                         :throw-exceptions false})]
    (if (= 200 (:status resp))
      (get-in resp [:body :choices 0 :message :content])
      (do
        (log/error "Cerebras invoke failed:" (:status resp) (:body resp))
        {:error "Cerebras invoke failed" :status (:status resp)}))))

;; ============================================================================
;; ORCHESTRATION LOGIC: 90-minute autonomous research run
;; ============================================================================

(defn generate-outline
  "Phase 1: Generate research plan with Claude Sonnet 4.5."
  [topic run-id]
  (log/info "Generating outline for topic:" topic)
  (let [system-prompt "You are an expert research planner. Create a detailed 20–30 page report outline with section titles, key questions, and citation placeholders."
        user-prompt (str "Topic: " topic "\n\nGenerate a comprehensive research outline covering introduction, methodology, key findings sections, case studies, limitations, and references. List 5–10 specific research questions to investigate.")
        outline-text (bedrock-invoke {:messages [{:role "user" :content user-prompt}]
                                      :system system-prompt
                                      :max-tokens 3000
                                      :temperature 0.3})]
    (cache-hset (str "run:" run-id) "outline" outline-text)
    (log/info "Outline generated and cached.")
    outline-text))

(defn extract-research-questions
  "Extract bullet-list questions from outline text (simple heuristic)."
  [outline-text]
  (->> (str/split-lines outline-text)
       (filter #(or (str/starts-with? % "- ") (str/starts-with? % "* ") (str/starts-with? % "? ")))
       (map #(str/replace % #"^[*\-\?]\s*" ""))
       (take 10)))

(defn search-and-gather
  "Phase 2: Multi-query Exa search + content extraction. Stores results in Dragonfly."
  [questions run-id]
  (log/info "Starting search phase for" (count questions) "questions.")
  (doseq [q questions]
    (let [search-res (exa-search {:query q :num-results 10 :type "neural"})
          result-ids (mapv :id (:results search-res))]
      (when (seq result-ids)
        (cache-sadd (str "run:" run-id ":search-ids") result-ids)
        (log/info "Gathered" (count result-ids) "results for question:" q))))
  (let [all-ids (cache-smembers (str "run:" run-id ":search-ids"))
        unique-ids (distinct all-ids)
        contents-result (exa-get-contents unique-ids)]
    (cache-hset (str "run:" run-id) "contents-raw" (json/generate-string contents-result))
    (log/info "Fetched contents for" (count unique-ids) "unique IDs.")
    contents-result))

(defn triage-sources
  "Phase 3: Use Grok 4 Fast to quickly score and filter sources."
  [contents-data run-id]
  (log/info "Triaging sources with Grok 4 Fast...")
  (let [summaries (map (fn [c] {:id (:id c) :title (:title c) :snippet (subs (:text c "") 0 (min 300 (count (:text c ""))))})
                       (:results contents-data))
        prompt (str "You are a research triage assistant. Below are source snippets. Rate each from 1–10 for relevance and reliability. Return JSON array: [{\"id\":\"...\", \"score\":8}, ...].\n\nSources:\n"
                    (json/generate-string summaries))
        triage-json (grok-fast-invoke {:messages [{:role "user" :content prompt}] :max-tokens 1500})
        scores (try (json/parse-string triage-json true) (catch Exception _ []))]
    (cache-hset (str "run:" run-id) "triage-scores" (json/generate-string scores))
    (log/info "Triage completed. Scores cached.")
    scores))

(defn synthesize-sections
  "Phase 4: Use Cerebras 120B for fast draft generation, then Sonnet for polish."
  [contents-data outline run-id]
  (log/info "Synthesizing report sections...")
  (let [sections (str/split outline #"\n##") ;; naive split by markdown headers
        draft-parts (atom [])]
    (doseq [section sections]
      (when (> (count section) 10)
        (let [notes (str "Outline section:\n" section "\n\nAvailable research data:\n"
                         (json/generate-string (take 5 (:results contents-data))))
              draft (cerebras-oss120b-invoke {:messages [{:role "user" :content (str "Write a detailed, citation-ready paragraph for this section:\n" notes)}]
                                              :max-tokens 1500
                                              :temperature 0.5})]
          (swap! draft-parts conj draft)
          (log/info "Section draft generated via Cerebras."))))
    (let [combined-draft (str/join "\n\n" @draft-parts)]
      (cache-hset (str "run:" run-id) "draft" combined-draft)
      (log/info "All section drafts combined and cached.")
      combined-draft)))

(defn final-polish
  "Phase 5: Final QA and polish with Claude Sonnet 4.5."
  [draft outline run-id]
  (log/info "Final polish with Claude Sonnet 4.5...")
  (let [system-prompt "You are a senior research editor. Polish this draft into a professional, citation-ready 20–30 page report. Ensure coherence, proper citations, and executive summary."
        user-prompt (str "Original outline:\n" outline "\n\nDraft report:\n" draft "\n\nProduce final polished report with title, abstract, sections, and references.")
        final-report (bedrock-invoke {:messages [{:role "user" :content user-prompt}]
                                      :system system-prompt
                                      :max-tokens 16000
                                      :temperature 0.2})]
    (cache-hset (str "run:" run-id) "final-report" final-report)
    (log/info "Final report complete and cached.")
    final-report))

(defn autonomous-research-pipeline
  "Full 90-minute autonomous pipeline. Returns run-id."
  [topic]
  (let [run-id (str "run-" (System/currentTimeMillis))]
    (future
      (try
        (log/info "Starting autonomous research pipeline for run:" run-id)
        (cache-hset (str "run:" run-id) "status" "running")
        (cache-hset (str "run:" run-id) "topic" topic)

        ;; Phase 1: Outline (0–5 min)
        (let [outline (generate-outline topic run-id)
              questions (extract-research-questions outline)]

          ;; Phase 2: Search + gather (5–50 min)
          (let [contents (search-and-gather questions run-id)]

            ;; Phase 3: Triage (50–60 min)
            (triage-sources contents run-id)

            ;; Phase 4: Synthesis (60–80 min)
            (let [draft (synthesize-sections contents outline run-id)]

              ;; Phase 5: Final polish (80–90 min)
              (final-polish draft outline run-id))))

        (cache-hset (str "run:" run-id) "status" "completed")
        (log/info "Pipeline completed for run:" run-id)
        (catch Exception e
          (log/error e "Pipeline failed for run:" run-id)
          (cache-hset (str "run:" run-id) "status" "failed")
          (cache-hset (str "run:" run-id) "error" (.getMessage e)))))
    run-id))

;; ============================================================================
;; HTTP API ROUTES
;; ============================================================================

(defroutes app-routes
  (GET "/health" []
       (resp/response {:status "ok"}))

  (POST "/api/start" {body :body}
        (let [topic (get body "topic")]
          (if (str/blank? topic)
            (-> (resp/response {:error "Missing topic"})
                (resp/status 400))
            (let [run-id (autonomous-research-pipeline topic)]
              (resp/response {:run_id run-id :status "started"})))))

  (GET "/api/status/:run-id" [run-id]
       (let [data (cache-hgetall (str "run:" run-id))]
         (if (empty? data)
           (-> (resp/response {:error "Run not found"})
               (resp/status 404))
           (resp/response (into {} (map (fn [[k v]] [(keyword k) v]) (partition 2 data)))))))

  (GET "/api/report/:run-id" [run-id]
       (let [report (cache-get (str "run:" run-id ":final-report"))]
         (if report
           (resp/response {:report report})
           (-> (resp/response {:error "Report not ready or not found"})
               (resp/status 404)))))

  (POST "/api/search" {body :body}
        (let [query (get body "query")
              num (get body "num_results" 10)]
          (resp/response (exa-search {:query query :num-results num}))))

  (POST "/api/contents" {body :body}
        (let [ids (get body "ids")]
          (resp/response (exa-get-contents ids))))

  (POST "/api/bedrock" {body :body}
        (let [messages (get body "messages")
              max-tok (get body "max_tokens" 2000)]
          (resp/response {:text (bedrock-invoke {:messages messages :max-tokens max-tok})})))

  (POST "/api/grok" {body :body}
        (let [messages (get body "messages")
              max-tok (get body "max_tokens" 1500)]
          (resp/response {:text (grok-fast-invoke {:messages messages :max-tokens max-tok})})))

  (POST "/api/cerebras" {body :body}
        (let [messages (get body "messages")
              max-tok (get body "max_tokens" 1500)]
          (resp/response {:text (cerebras-oss120b-invoke {:messages messages :max-tokens max-tok})})))

  (route/not-found {:error "Not found"}))

(def app
  (-> app-routes
      (wrap-json-body {:keywords? true})
      wrap-json-response
      wrap-params
      (wrap-cors :access-control-allow-origin [#".*"]
                 :access-control-allow-methods [:get :post :options]
                 :access-control-allow-headers ["content-type" "authorization"])))

(defn -main [& args]
  (validate-config!)
  (log/info "Starting autonomous research agent server on port" (:port config))
  (run-jetty app {:port (:port config) :join? false}))

Ez egy Clojure-ban írt HTTP szerver és autonóm kutatási ügynök backend, amely a Ring/Jetty ökoszisztémára épül Compojure alapú útvonalkezeléssel és JSON middleware-rel. Külső AI-szolgáltatásokat integrál (Exa webkeresés, Amazon Bedrock/Claude, xAI Grok 4 Fast, Cerebras gpt-oss-120B) és Dragonfly/Redis kompatibilis gyorsítótárat használ a teljesítmény és robusztusság érdekében.[1][2][3][4][5][6][7][8][9]

### Szerver és routing
A kiszolgáló a Ring HTTP absztrakcióját használja, amely a Clojure webalkalmazások de facto szabványa a handler–middleware modellre építve. A futtatást a beépített Jetty adapter végzi, amely a run-jetty hívással indít egy beágyazott Jetty webszervert. Az útvonalak Compojure DSL-lel vannak definiálva, ami tömör módszer HTTP végpontok leírására Ring fölött.[2][10][4][1]

### JSON kezelés
A válaszok és kérések JSON-ra/JSON-ból alakítását a Ring JSON middleware biztosítja, amely a wrap-json-body és wrap-json-response rétegekkel működik. A tényleges JSON kódoláshoz gyakori választás a Cheshire könyvtár, amely gyors JSON encode/decode funkciókat kínál Clojure-hoz. A middleware célja, hogy a route-handlerek Clojure mapokkal dolgozzanak, a JSON transzformációt átláthatóan kezelve.[11][12][13][9][14]

### Gyorsítótárazás és állapot
A rendszer Dragonfly-t használ Redis/Memcached API-kompatibilis in-memory adatbázisként, így Redis-parancsokkal (GET, SETEX, HGETALL, SMEMBERS stb.) kezelhető cache-ként. A Dragonfly célja, hogy zökkenőmentes migrációt és jelentős teljesítménynyereséget biztosítson Redis-kompatibilis módon. A protokoll-kompatibilitás lehetővé teszi a meglévő Redis-kliensek használatát minimális vagy nulla kódmódosítással.[3][15][16]

### Exa webkeresés integráció
Az Exa API a weben végez intelligens keresést, és a találatokból strukturált tartalom kinyerését is támogatja egy dedikált search végponton. Az Exa platform célja a valós idejű AI-alapú keresés és tartalom-extrakció LLM-ek számára optimalizálva. Az ökoszisztémában általános a “search + contents” minta, ahol előbb keresés történik, majd a kiválasztott találatok teljes szövege kerül lekérésre.[5][17][18]

### Bedrock/Claude hívások és SigV4
Az Amazon Bedrock modellhívások az InvokeModel művelettel történnek a /model/{modelId}/invoke végponton, amely a kérést és a paramétereket a törzsben várja. Ezek a kérések AWS Signature Version 4 aláírást igényelnek, ami a törzs hash-ét, dátumot, régiót és szolgáltatást figyelembe vevő aláírási folyamat. A Bedrock egységes módot kínál különböző foundation modellek meghívására, beleértve az Anthropic Claude család tagjait is.[19][6][20]

### xAI Grok 4 Fast triage
A Grok 4 Fast az xAI költséghatékony, nagy kontextusú, webböngészésre és eszközhasználatra tanított modellje, amely API-n keresztül érhető el. Nyilvános aggregátorok és bejelentések a 2M tokenes kontextusablakot és magas költséghatékonyságot emelik ki különböző használati módokkal. Független hazai beszámolók is a böngészési/ügynöki képességeket és elérhetőséget hangsúlyozzák.[21][22][23][7]

### Cerebras GPT-OSS-120B vázlatírás
A Cerebras Inference Chat Completions API OpenAI-kompatibilis mintával hívható, és támogatja a gpt-oss-120b modellt. A Cerebras dokumentáció külön kiemeli, hogy a “gpt-oss-120b” a chat completions végponton elérhető modellazonosító. Közösségi és integrációs útmutatók a nagy áteresztőképességű inferenciát és gyors válaszidőt hangsúlyozzák ezzel a modellel.[8][24][25]

### Kutatási pipeline logika
A kód által megvalósított pipeline tipikusan: outline generálás (Claude/Bedrock), kérdéslista kivonat, Exa keresés és tartalomgyűjtés, források triage (Grok 4 Fast), gyors vázlat (Cerebras), majd végső csiszolás (Claude/Bedrock). Az ilyen többmodell-eszközlánc célja, hogy a webes forrásokból vett naprakész információt strukturált jelentéssé szintetizálja. A komponensek mind API-n keresztül hívhatók, így automatizált, hosszabb kutatási futtatások is megvalósíthatók.[17][6][5][8]

### Mikor hasznos
Olyan riportkészítő és információkinyerő feladatoknál hasznos, ahol a webes keresés, tartalom-összegyűjtés és LLM-alapú szintézis kombinációja értéket ad. A valós idejű, naprakész adatokhoz Exa biztosít hozzáférést, míg a szerkesztett outputot a nagy nyelvi modellek adják Bedrockon és más inference szolgáltatókon. Nagy volumenű vagy hosszú dokumentumok feldolgozásakor a Grok 4 Fast nagy kontextusa és a Cerebras nagy áteresztése különösen előnyös lehet.[6][7][5][17][8]

### Biztonsági és üzemeltetési jegyzetek
Bedrock hívásoknál mindig szükséges a helyes SigV4 aláírás, ami a kérés törzsétől és időbélyegétől is függ, ezért dinamikusan kell előállítani. A modellhívás szintaxisa és az engedélyezés az AWS dokumentáció szerint történik, a “bedrock:InvokeModel” jogosultsági művelettel. A Jetty-s Ring szerver beágyazott módon futtatható, ami egyszerűsíti a telepítést és a hordozhatóságot.[2][19][6]
